verdicts.reason: A keeps 'Smart Home / GADGETS' legible in white at right on a dark crop of the robot photo, with a clear headline size step and left-to-right reading. But the purple circle, the brand's main colour, is cut down to a meaningless sliver in the bottom-left corner, and the frame line and dot pattern are gone, so it reads as a cropped photo with text dropped on it. B shrinks the purple circle to a tiny blob in the middle of the banner, and the text inside it is too small to read. The rest of the canvas is an unreadable dark photo crop, with no headline hierarchy and no usable message.
